notes.note: Discard: the host sends the dependent hunk numbers with the confirm request (computed from the plan's needs) and discards after the developer confirms; never blocked.

Working tree drift: before every stage/unstage/discard, run git apply --check for that hunk. If it fails, refuse the action and show 'Files changed since this plan was made' with a Rerun review button that recollects hunks and replans. No file watcher, no plan merging.
